Name: NPC Map Locations Performance Patch - on-demand synchronization
Author: xihanovo
Description:
[center][size=150][color=#2E86C1]NPC Map Locations Performance Patch[/color][/size]
[color=#5D6D7E]On‑Demand Sync for NPC Map Locations[/color][/center]
[center][color=#5D6D7E]NPC地图位置按需同步性能优化补丁[/color][/center]
[line]
[b]Overview[/b]
This patch adds on‑demand synchronization to NPC Map Locations. NPC positions are computed and broadcast only when any player (farmhand or host) has the map open; all computation stops when the map is closed, dramatically reducing CPU usage. Both the host and all farmhands must install this patch, otherwise sync will not work.

[b]How it works[/b]
[code]
Map opens → triggers sync → computation starts
Map closes → sends stop → computation stops
Any player opening the map triggers the logic.[/code][center][/center]
[center][/center]
[line]
[b]简介[/b]
本补丁为 NPC Map Locations 添加按需同步机制。仅当任意玩家（客机或主机）打开地图时，才计算并广播 NPC 位置；地图关闭时计算完全停止，大幅降低 CPU 占用。主机与所有客机必须同时安装本补丁，否则同步失效。

[b]工作原理[/b]
[code]
打开地图 → 触发同步 → 开始计算
关闭地图 → 发送停止 → 停止计算
任意玩家打开地图均触发逻辑。[/code][line]
